To better understand how innate immune responses to vaccination
can lead to lasting protective immunity, we used a systems ap-
proach to deﬁne immune signatures in humans over 1 wk following
MRKAd5/HIV vaccination that predicted subsequent HIV-speciﬁc T-
cell responses.

Within 24 h, striking increases in peripheral blood
mononuclear cell gene expression associated with inﬂammation,
IFN response, and myeloid cell trafﬁcking occurred, and lympho-
cyte-speciﬁc transcripts decreased.

These alterations were corrobo-

Serum cytokine analysis was performed using the
